newsitem.title: UK: British Borneo down again on negative press.
newsitem.headline: British Borneo down again on negative press.

text.p: Shares in British Borneo Petroleum Syndicate Plc dropped on Monday, extending Friday's sharp falls after negative press comment following last week's disappointing drilling report.

The Financial Times' influential Lex column on Saturday said it was doubtful the risks facing the stock were fully priced in and advised investors to take profits on the stock, which almost doubled in value in the early months of the year.
The column said investors had come to believe the company could go wrong and Friday's statement was a "salutary reminder that oil exploration...is simply not like that."
The stock was down 61-1/2p at 13.30 stg by 0754 GMT in volume of 101,815 shares.
British Borneo shares fell 148-1/2p on Friday after the company said its Gulf of Mexico Green Canyon exploration well had produced very heavy -- and therefore less valuable -- oil.
